description: Digest-pinned corpus inputs for the Hramatka engine. The DB files are NEVER committed; they mount read-only from HRAMATKA_DATA_DIR and are verified against these digests at startup. sources.db is optional for slice-1 (not opened) but pins the bundle identity used in the bake fingerprint.

source.note: digests captured from the operator's local protected build 2026-07-10
